rule: Accounts must match the exact reporting legal entity, not merely the public brand.
Consolidated group accounts and parent-only accounts are stored as different reporting perimeters.
Grant-in-Aid is recorded from audited accounts and reconciled to departmental/framework evidence; cash received and income recognised are not assumed identical.
National Lottery distribution income is never combined with taxpayer Grant-in-Aid.
Capital grants, restricted grants and unrestricted operating support remain separate where accounts permit.
Donated objects/gifts in kind are separated from liquid philanthropic income.
Commercial/earned income is not treated as philanthropy.
Staff costs are extracted with headcount/FTE only where the same accounts define the measure.
Reserves, endowments, cash and investments are separate balance-sheet concepts.
A missing note/amount is unresolved, never zero.
Board membership is captured from a dated current institutional or formal appointment source.
Appointment authority is a separate fact from office-holder identity.
Ministerial appointment, Prime Ministerial appointment, Crown appointment, board appointment and informal consultation are never collapsed into 'government-appointed'.
Executive management and governing trustees/directors are separate populations.
Historical office-holders are retained with term dates rather than overwritten.
